# Plugin.Maui.ApiCache

Lightweight HTTP/API response cache for .NET MAUI: CacheFirst, NetworkFirst, StaleWhileRevalidate, NetworkOnly, and CacheOnly.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.ApiCache
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ApiCache
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-api-cache
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ApiCache

Registration: `UseApiCache / AddApiCache` — see README.md.

```csharp
services.AddApiCache(options =>
{
    options.DefaultExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);
});

var response = await apiCache.GetAsync<Customer>("/customers");
```

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I cache API GET responses in MAUI?
- CacheFirst / NetworkFirst / StaleWhileRevalidate for mobile
- Show the last customer list when the device is offline

## Do not use when

- The need is retry / circuit breaker / 401 refresh (use Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience)
- The need is offline-first local writes and conflicts (use Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync)
- The need is captive-portal / real-internet detection (use Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor)
